name: Sodium benzoate
what_it_is: The sodium salt of benzoic acid, which occurs naturally in cranberries, prunes and cinnamon.
why_its_added: Stops mould, yeast and bacteria growing, mainly in sour foods like soft drinks, pickles and sauces.

india.note: FSSAI sets these limits for the BENZOATES family as a whole, not for this one substance. Maximum level depends on the food. Examples below.

eu.note: EFSA has assessed the safety of this additive, but we have no public record of its current authorisation in the EU.

usa.note: Generally Recognised As Safe (GRAS) for direct addition to food (21 CFR 184.1733)

eu_safety_opinion.title: Scientific Opinion on the re-evaluation of benzoic acid -E 210-, sodium benzoate -E 211-, potassium benzoate -E 212- and calcium benzoate -E 213- as food additives

safe_daily_limit.unit: mg per kg of body weight per day

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.
